title: GeoAI Blog Series: Trouble in AI Paradise: Get the Data Right First!
summary: It comes as no surprise that the absence of a focused data strategy centered on location intelligence is a significant hurdle to the practical application of AI to Real Estate planning. Real Estate executives and GIS experts agreed that in the absence of a holistic data strategy, the organization suffered from three typical roadblocks to leveraging AI effectively: 1) data silos within the organization - non-integrated spatial and other data sources, 2) missing data - incomplete consumer or real estate supply data, 3) acquiring unique sources of new data for competitive advantage.
